refused_program.body:
set -u

base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1

git merge --no-ff --no-commit {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

if [ ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)" ]; then
  echo "merge did not start" >&2
  exit 1
fi

tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$tmp/conflicted"

while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  if ! git cat-file -e "MERGE_HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    git rm -q -f -- "$f" || exit 1
    continue
  fi
  git show "MERGE_HEAD:$f" > "$tmp/up" || exit 1
  if git cat-file -e "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    git show "HEAD:$f" > "$tmp/local" || exit 1
  else
    : > "$tmp/local"
  fi
  cp "$tmp/up" "$tmp/result"
  git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD -- "$f" > "$tmp/diff"
  awk '
    function flush(   i) {
      if (!del && nplus > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= nplus; i++) print plus[i] }
      nplus = 0; del = 0
    }
    /^@@/ { flush(); seen = 1; next }
    !seen { next }
    /^-/ { del = 1; next }
    /^\+/ { plus[++nplus] = substr($0, 2); next }
    END { flush() }
  ' "$tmp/diff" > "$tmp/adds"
  while IFS= read -r add; do
    [ -n "$add" ] || continue
    if grep -qxF -- "$add" "$tmp/result"; then
      continue
    fi
    prev=$(awk -v want="$add" '
      !found && $0 == want { if (NR > 1) print prevline; found = 1; next }
      { prevline = $0 }
    ' "$tmp/local")
    if [ -n "$prev" ] && grep -qxF -- "$prev" "$tmp/result"; then
      awk -v prev="$prev" -v add="$add" '{ print } !done && $0 == prev { print add; done = 1 }' "$tmp/result" > "$tmp/result.new" && mv "$tmp/result.new" "$tmp/result"
    else
      nextline=$(awk -v want="$add" '
        !found && $0 == want { found = 1; next }
        found { print; exit }
      ' "$tmp/local")
      if [ -n "$nextline" ] && grep -qxF -- "$nextline" "$tmp/result"; then
        awk -v nxt="$nextline" -v add="$add" '!done && $0 == nxt { print add; done = 1 } { print }' "$tmp/result" > "$tmp/result.new" && mv "$tmp/result.new" "$tmp/result"
      else
        printf '%s\n' "$add" >> "$tmp/result"
      fi
    fi
  done < "$tmp/adds"
  cat "$tmp/result" > "$f"
  git add -- "$f" || exit 1
done < "$tmp/conflicted"

git commit --no-edit || exit 1
